| R-05 | ubiquitous | The system shall make every pricing decision for a priced order. | `result == "price" => pct != "na" && mode != "na" && flat != "na"` | SRC-1 Pricing |

| R-07 | event | When a BOGO order is priced, the system shall charge half the items and give no volume discount. | `coupon == "BOGO" && result == "price" => mode == "bogo" && pct in ["0", "5", "10"]` | SRC-1 Pricing 1, Pricing 2 |
| R-08 | ubiquitous | The system shall charge half the items only for BOGO orders. | `coupon != "BOGO" => mode != "bogo"` | SRC-1 Pricing 1 |
| R-09 | event | When a FLAT500 order is priced, the system shall take 500 cents off. | `coupon == "FLAT500" && result == "price" => flat == "500"` | SRC-1 Pricing 4 |
| R-10 | ubiquitous | The system shall take a flat amount off only for FLAT500 orders. | `coupon != "FLAT500" => flat != "500"` | SRC-1 Pricing 4 |
| R-11 | state | While the discount parts add up to 25 or more, the system shall apply exactly 25. | `tier == "gold" && day == "weekend" && qty == "q50_100" && coupon in ["none", "PCT10", "FLAT500"] => pct == "25"` | SRC-1 Pricing 2 |
